entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon prince of Innistrad released with the Sundering of the Helvault; leader of the Skirsdag cult after Griselbrand.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: Prison of demons; its Sundering released Ormendahl.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: Demon killed by Liliana, previously leader of the Skirsdag.

entities.name: Skirsdag cult
entities.description: Demon-worshipping cult Ormendahl came to lead.

entities.name: Lunarch Inquisition
entities.description: Persecution driven by the church's bishops, influenced by Ormendahl.

entities.name: Bishop Jerren
entities.description: Lunarch Council member and Ormendahl's high priest.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi Titan whose influence overcame Ormendahl.

entities.name: Henrika Domnathi
entities.description: Vampire who tried to raise an army and a ritual to bring Ormendahl back.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Thwarted Henrika's plans together with Odric.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: Thwarted Henrika's plans together with Thalia.

events.summary: Ormendahl escapes the Helvault and spreads terror across Innistrad.
events.quote: After escaping his imprisonment in the Helvault, Ormendahl began spreading terror across Innistrad.

events.summary: Ormendahl survives Avacyn's purge by hiding in caverns beneath the cathedral.
events.quote: He survived Avacyn 's purge by hiding in caverns deep beneath the cathedral.

events.summary: After Liliana kills Griselbrand, Ormendahl takes his place as leader of the Skirsdag cult.
events.quote: he took the other demon's place as the leader of the Skirsdag cult

events.summary: Ormendahl's influence over the council, through Bishop Jerren, whips the church into frenzy.
events.quote: used the uncertainty of the council to whip the church into an even more violent frenzy

events.summary: Ormendahl possesses a cathar's wife, causing murders blamed on werewolves; she reveals him before she is killed.
events.quote: Ormendahl once possessed a cathar 's wife, causing her to commit a string of murders that would be blamed on werewolves .

events.summary: When the Travails begin, Ormendahl falls under Emrakul's influence and loses his own power.
events.quote: the ambitious Ormendahl fell under Emrakul 's influence and lost his own

events.summary: Henrika Domnathi tries a ritual to bring Ormendahl back but is thwarted by Thalia and Odric.
events.quote: her plans were thwarted by Thalia and Odric

relations.quote: he took the other demon's place as the leader of the Skirsdag cult
Bishop Jerren , who sat on the Lunarch Council, was Ormendhal's high priest

relations.note: tried to raise an army and resurrect him
relations.quote: Henrika Domnathi tried to raise an army of unholy cathars for Ormendahl.
